text:
Type: stainless steel rail wall shelf
Use: holding dishes, jars and utensils above a counter, towels in a bathroom; kitchen, bathroom, laundry room
Style: industrial, minimalist, modern
Materials: brushed stainless steel rails, steel side brackets, small steel S-hooks
Colors: brushed silver stainless steel
Shape: long flat shelf of parallel round rods on two slim wall brackets, small hooks hanging below, airy and open, light visual weight
Feel: clean, practical, crisp, utilitarian
Goes with: white tiles, stainless appliances, wood countertops, black accents; industrial or modern kitchens and bathrooms
